summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K disclosing the issuance of up to 334,809,216 new ordinary shares in connection with its acquisition of Webster Financial Corporation. The registrant is the acquirer, funding the deal via a stock consideration. The filing notes that Banco Santander is relying on exemptions under the Prospectus Regulation and has published an exemption document on its website, filed with the CNMV. No price per share, premium, or closing date is provided. The deal involves a share issuance to complete the acquisition, and the exemption document is available for review. Watch for regulatory approvals and shareholder votes.
